# Merqurie — Independent Web Systems

> Official URL: https://merqurie.com/
> Founder: Jagadish (ex-Amazon, frontier AI evaluator for Google Gemini via Turing)
> WhatsApp Hotline: +91 73586 18789

## Summary
Merqurie is an independent software studio that hand-crafts high-performance, mobile-first web platforms for growing businesses, healthcare suppliers, schools, and commercial retailers.

## Core Guarantees & Philosophy
- **Speed-Budgeted Edge Delivery**: Lean, hand-built pages around 0.5 MB on mobile — no page builders, no plugin bloat — audited with Lighthouse at every launch.
- **Zero Monthly Retainer Fees**: Clients pay once for the custom build. No forced agency maintenance fees or monthly retainer contracts.
- **10-Second Phone Admin Cockpit**: Clients can edit headlines, prices, announcements, and photos directly from their smartphone in 10 seconds without developer bills.
- **1-Tap WhatsApp Lead Funnels**: Frictionless customer enquiry routing directly to business owners on WhatsApp.
- **100% Client Code Sovereignty**: On launch day, full GitHub repository code, domain DNS, and cloud accounts are transferred to the client. Zero vendor lock-in.

## Verified Live Deployments
- **PMS Solution Healthcare (pmssolution.co.in)**: Chennai hospital medical equipment platform for ICU beds and oxygen concentrators with lean, speed-budgeted loading and 1-tap WhatsApp quotes.
- **Unique Power Shito-Ryu Karate School (upskskarate.com)**: Sports academy platform managing schedules and parent admissions for 1,000+ students with lean, speed-budgeted loading.

## Pricing Packages
All packages are a one-time build with no monthly retainer; the exact figure is given in a written proposal after a short call.

1. **Starter Edge**: Up to 5 fast pages written for the business, a one-tap WhatsApp button on every page, a ~0.5 MB page weight, 10-second phone text editing, Google Search and Google Maps setup, full code and domain ownership, 30 days of post-launch fixes.
2. **Growth Engine**: Everything in Starter Edge, plus a product or service catalogue with photos and specs, one-tap WhatsApp orders and instant quote forms, visitor analytics (city, device, clicks), a Lighthouse speed report at launch, self-serve price and photo edits.
3. **Custom Cloud**: Everything in Growth Engine, plus a custom web app built around the workflow, secure client or student logins, booking and enquiry forms, live price calculators, and online payments via UPI, cards and Razorpay.

Free 24h sample preview available for qualified businesses at https://merqurie.com/.
